scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Hedra presents character-driven video creation through several styles of a seated spokesperson and a funding announcement.
explains_well: The same seated composition across cartoon, drawn, knitted and realistic-looking versions makes style variety easy to compare.
unclear: The film shows finished characters but no input, control or generation step that explains how a user creates one.
scenario: Use a digital spokesperson to announce a funding round.
product_clear_basis: The character montage includes visible generative-AI model text; the ASR also identifies the opening as a digital version.

scenes.action: A large-eyed cartoon man sits on a blue sofa in a city apartment and gestures toward the viewer. A Hedra watermark remains at the bottom.
scenes.design: Polished three-dimensional cartoon look and fixed medium framing.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 0–11s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: Character cards pass across a dark background, followed by a neon-lit woman, a podcast-style speaker and a glamorous product presenter.
scenes.design: Rounded character cards, varied realism and short text captions.
scenes.purpose: Show different character and content styles.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 11–23s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: A black funding card states $32M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz beneath the Hedra mark.
scenes.design: Large pink funding figure with a subtle pink glow.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 23–32s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: The seated spokesperson returns as a flat illustrated character in a similar city apartment, gesturing with changing expressions.
scenes.design: Drawn outlines and softer shaded color.
scenes.purpose: Continue the message while demonstrating another style.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 32–41s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: The same seated setup becomes a knitted or crocheted-looking character and room. Hands and facial expressions change while the composition stays stable.
scenes.design: Visible yarn-like texture across character, cushions and room.
scenes.purpose: Make material variety a central visual example.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 41–57s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: A realistic-looking man in a black shirt speaks from a sofa with the city behind him, using hand gestures.
scenes.design: Natural-looking room and human proportions; provenance unverified.
scenes.purpose: Extend the style range to a realistic-looking presenter.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 57–73s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: The opening cartoon style returns, then the film closes on the white Hedra symbol and name against black.
scenes.design: Return to the original composition and simple logo card.
scenes.purpose: Close the announcement with visual continuity.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 73–85.101s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

sound.detail: The coherent ASR draft identifies the opening as a digital version made with Character 3, describes creator and marketing uses, announces a $32 million Series A, and links funding to research, hiring and easier character workflows. It also claims this video took less time to make. These are script claims, not verified timing or production facts; delivery and lip sync were not heard.

lessons.keep: Use the same composition across styles to show range clearly.
lessons.avoid: Treating a finished-output reel as an explanation of creation controls.
lessons.open: Input method, output provenance, time savings, lip sync and actual voice remain unverified.
try: For Tin, keep one campaign message and layout fixed while comparing several approved visual styles.
Add a brief character input and style choice before returning to the finished spokesperson.

comparison.story: Introduce a digital spokesperson. → Show different character and content styles. → State the announcement clearly. → Continue the message while demonstrating another style. → Make material variety a central visual example. → Extend the style range to a realistic-looking presenter. → Close the announcement with visual continuity.
